method: Offline Chromium, real CDP mouse (1280x720) and multi-touch (844x390, DPR 2) on the 2.5D raid host, seed 42, layered coast map. Fixtures place the player and enemies, hand weapons and freeze AI.

steps.name: a still pointer keeps the aim while the camera eases
at the map edge a still pointer keeps the aim too: the look-ahead stops on the edge
firing with a still pointer keeps the aim
muzzle flash on the barrel tip; tracers leave the tip
a blow's flash and kick are drawn on slow frames
a critical hit turns the hit marker critical; each kill marker asks for one confirm sound
mouse fire modes: pistol once, M4A1 every 0.1 s
a shot out of an unrevealed room draws nothing over it
walls, a closed door and a corner stop the bullet at the surface

cases.spot: west face just above the SW corner
west face just above the SW corner
inside the west room at the closed west door (13,10)
inside the west room at the closed west door (13,10)

steps.name: touch fire modes: outer ring repeats, inner ring never fires
